outcomeDiff: Expected and actual match. The only plan deviation is CHK-003 used scripts/verify-codex-assets.mjs for focused resolver tests instead of creating packages/main/src/tasks/worktree-codex-gate-command-smoke.ts; delivery reviewer accepted equivalent coverage.
limitations: none — fully covered by focused Node/Lattice tests, reviewer passes, delivery-check, validate JSON, and Codex adapter verification.
